idea-plugin.name: Runners Bar
idea-plugin.description:
Your most used run configurations, one click away. Runners Bar adds a slim bar above the status bar (or below the toolbar) that holds run configurations as tabs. Click a tab and it runs. No dropdown, no searching, no switching the selected configuration.

Features

  • One-click start: every tab runs its configuration directly, or debugs it if you switched the tab to debug mode.
  • Arrow menu per tab: debug once (or run once without the debugger), toggle debug mode, stop, open the configuration's settings, move or remove the tab.
  • Groups: keep different sets of tabs, e.g. Frontend, Backend or Deploy, and switch between them. A configuration can be part of several groups.
  • Drag and drop: reorder tabs by dragging them like editor tabs; drag a tab out of the bar and drop it to remove it; press Escape to cancel.
  • New configurations: create a run configuration from the + menu, it lands in the bar right away.
  • Your layout: place the bar below the toolbar or above the status bar, align the tabs left, center or right, put the controls on either side and hide the menu arrow if you prefer the right click. Set your defaults once and override them per project.
  • Running state: running configurations are highlighted.
  • Follows renamed configurations, keeps the bar per project and stores it in your personal workspace (not in version control).

Usage

  • Click + to add an existing or a new run configuration. Its Runners Bar submenu creates groups, hides the bar in the current project and changes position and alignment.
  • Settings: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Runners Bar, with defaults for all projects and the values of the current project.
  • Show or hide the bar via View | Appearance | Runners Bar.
  • Don't need it in a particular project? Choose Hide in This Project in the + menu's Runners Bar submenu, or toggle View | Appearance | Runners Bar in This Project.

Works in all JetBrains IDEs based on the IntelliJ Platform (PhpStorm, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, ...). UI available in English and German.
